How can you make the world a better place? By being patient.
Life is for everyone. It means not only humans, but also animals and plants. The fact is that humans are more intelligent. We will all be happy if we stop pollution.
Humanity is important. Now our Mother Teresa has so much humanity. Although she isn't from our country, she served food to the poor. Many were jealous and lost humanity.
This should also be mentioned. There is a lot of pollution in our world. But plants absorb that pollution and give us pure and fresh air.
But if we are killing them without taking good care of them, then what will give us pure air? That is why we should plant them rather than kill them.

We need a lot of fuel to drive our vehicles. But it is decreasing day by day. We should use the vehicles sparingly. If we reduce vehicles, two good things will happen. The first is, we will save fuel. The second is, we will reduce pollution.

We do not even take good care of the animals. We use animal names to abuse someone, it's so wrong. It’s like insulting the animals. We should feed animals and take care of them with love. Even they are like us.
We write, draw, and read on paper. They all come from our beloved trees. We get paper only when we cut down trees.

If our trees die, then our oxygen reserves and our fresh air will not be there.Then you, and I, and the animals will die. That is why paper should always be saved. Everyone will be happy, if you follow what I say. We are the ones who save our world. Animals, humans, trees and even our Mother Earth will be happy. That is my wish.
What is your wish? We can only achieve them if we are alive. I will do all this and keep the mother earth happy.
